reviewer_role: Judge A — Browser/Audio DSP Systems Specialist

strengths.claim: Decoupled audio hardware clock from network arrival jitter
strengths.evidence: StayPcmPlaybackProcessor AudioWorklet processes on 128-sample render quanta; absorbed 0-100ms jitter with 0 underflow gaps in docs/bench-results/jitter-matrix.json

strengths.claim: Stateful sample-rate conversion preserves phase across chunks
strengths.evidence: StreamingResampler carries fractional phase and boundary samples across 24k -> 48k/44.1k conversions; verified in tests/voice-audio/resampler.test.ts with boundary jump < 0.1
AudioWorklet cancels epoch synchronously; p50 stop latency 48ms, p95 92ms, 0 stale samples leaked in docs/bench-results/barge-in.json

defects.repro: If browser lacks AudioWorklet support, fallback AudioBufferSourceNode path uses 80ms lookahead with higher jitter sensitivity
defects.proposed_fix: AudioWorklet is supported on >98.5% of modern browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari 14.1+, Firefox 76+); fallback handles legacy environments safely

missing_evidence: Long-term physical AirPods Bluetooth route change audition under background tab audio contention
one_reason_to_reject: Initial 100ms prebuffer adds 100ms latency to time-to-first-audible-audio compared to zero-buffer streaming
one_compelling_reason_to_award: Flawless elimination of audible dropout gaps up to 100ms network jitter without robotic clicks or frame corruption
